name: Coteccio
summary: Italian negative trick-avoidance game where most points loses a life, unless one player takes all five tricks.
rules_text: Played anticlockwise with a 40-card Italian deck. Up to 7 players are dealt 5 cards each from a shuffled deck. No trumps, must follow suit if able. Highest of led suit wins trick, winner leads next. Card points: Ace 6, King 5, Knight 4, Jack 3, others 0, plus 6 points for winner of last trick. Pool and 4 lives each. Normally player(s) with most points lose one life. If same player wins first four tricks they may annul hand for a redeal, or lead last card: if it wins they gain one life and all others lose one (capotto), if it loses they lose one and last-trick winner gains one. Players with zero lives may pay to get lives equal to current minimum if at least two others remain, otherwise eliminated. Last survivor wins pool.
rating_reason: Italian negative trick game, hidden hands, sequential play
